page_title: Underground waste containers: how they work
intro: Our neighbourhood has underground waste containers. They only open with the access card (toegangspas) of your home. Here you can read how to use them.
trust: Free. This website never asks for money, a payment or personal data. No cookies, no tracking.
translation_note: This is a volunteer translation of the official Dutch explanation by IOK, the waste company. If in doubt, the Dutch text applies.
steps: Go to the right container. The screen says: “Welkom, bied je pas aan.” (Welcome, show your card.)
Hold your access card under the screen for a few seconds.
The screen says: “Pas geaccepteerd.” (Card accepted.) Take your card away.
Put your waste in the container.
containers_intro: The official rules are in the IOK sorting guide and on bettersorting.be. Below are a few examples.
containers_note: All containers open with your access card. Only general waste costs money.

rest.name: General waste (restafval)
rest.how: In a closed bag of maximum 30 litres. Any kind of bag is fine, as long as the lid closes easily afterwards.
rest.no: No PMD, paper or glass. No large objects, electrical appliances, batteries, paint or chemical products.

pmd.name: PMD
pmd.subtitle: Plastic packaging, Metal packaging and Drink cartons
pmd.how: Loose in the container, not in a (blue) bag. Empty the packaging and do not put items inside each other.
pmd.yes: Plastic bottles, flasks, pots, trays, films and bags. Cans, tins, aerosol cans, lids and caps. Drink cartons (milk, juice).
pmd.no: No plastic objects that are not packaging (toys, buckets). No packaging of motor oil, paint, glue, pesticides or fuel.

paper.name: Paper and cardboard (papier en karton)
paper.how: Loose in the container, not in a bag. Fold or tear boxes into small pieces.
paper.yes: Newspapers, magazines, leaflets, letters, envelopes, books, cardboard boxes, paper bread bags.
paper.no: No dirty or greasy paper (pizza boxes, chip trays). No kitchen paper, tissues, aluminium foil or wallpaper.

never_title: Never leave waste next to the container
never_text: Not even when the container is full or broken. That is illegal dumping (sluikstorten): you can get a heavy fine. Take your waste back home and report the problem to IOK.

blocked.q: …the container does not open, is full or is broken?
blocked.a: Take your waste back home. Report the problem to IOK. IOK will fix it as soon as possible.

lost.q: …I lost my access card or it is broken?
lost.a: Ask IOK for a new card. A new card costs 5 euros.
lost.hours: Monday to Thursday 8:30 to 16:30, Friday 8:30 to 16:00

moved_in.q: …I just moved here and have no card?
moved_in.a: The card belongs to the home, not to the person. Ask your landlord or the previous resident for the card. Register your address with the city of Turnhout. No card? Contact IOK.

moving_out.a: Leave the access card and the manual in the home. Report your move to the city.

bag.a: Use a smaller bag (maximum 30 litres), so the lid closes easily. Never put the bag next to the container.

elsewhere.q: …I have glass, large objects, electrical appliances or chemical waste?
elsewhere.a: These are not allowed in these containers. Take them to the recycling park (recyclagepark). Bring your identity card.

cost.q: …I want to know what I pay?
cost.a: General waste costs a fixed amount each time you use the container. It is taken from the waste account (DIFTAR) of your home. PMD and paper are free.
